verdicts.line: If Mark says anything to you about the money, you tell me first. Okay? Promise me. / Doesn't matter, baby. Eat something. You'll be late. Go on.
verdicts.why: Mom visibly wants something on both last screens: to stand first between her and Mark (sit_with_mom), to keep what she tried hidden and get her out the door (ask_mom). Not a sexual step, so no earlier canvas needed; Mark's want (the rent) is shown on opening.kitchen_rent.

verdicts.line: Then she stops, a plate in her hands. / She pushes the toast across the counter and turns the tap on hard.
verdicts.why: Each path goes one step past opening.handover's "I tried.": she asks for a promise against Mark (sit_with_mom), or she shuts the subject outright and sends her off (ask_mom). The Quests line and the trims leave both steps intact.
PLAN.md declares Zoe the companion and Brooke the rival, two different people; companion-is-rival isn't declared, and neither appears on these screens.
